Elevate Your Living Experience, 3BR/2BA Duplex in Killeen!

Experience contemporary living at its finest at 1701 N Park St, Killeen, TX. This stunning duplex, built in 2021, offers 876 sq ft of thoughtfully designed space, perfect for those seeking comfort and convenience. This beautifully designed unit features three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, ideal for everyone needing extra room. The open-concept living area is adorned with elegant granite countertops and durable vinyl plank flooring, adding a touch of sophistication. The kitchen is a chef's delight, equipped with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinet space, and an electric range, making meal preparation a breeze. Air conditioning throughout the unit ensures a comfortable living environment year-round. Additionally, the separate utility room with a stackable washer and dryer makes laundry day hassle-free.

Its prime location provides easy access to top-notch schools, shopping centers, and Fort Hood, TX, making it a convenient choice for your next home.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to call 1701 N Park St your new home. Schedule a tour today and experience the best of modern living in Killeen, TX!
